record.original_question: If the limit h = lim_{n -> infinity} log f_Y(n) / n exists for a hyperbolic billiard table Y, must this finite positive number coincide with the topological entropy of the billiard map?

evidence.quote: The set of periodic points of any period is finite; let f_Y(n) be the number of periodic points, whose period is less than or equal to n.
Problem 6. If the limit in equation (3) exists, is 0 < h < infinity the topological entropy of the billiard map?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y$ be a hyperbolic billiard table (a planar billiard table whose associated billiard map on the boundary phase space is hyperbolic, e.g. a Sinai dispersing billiard or a Bunimovich-type billiard). Assume that the set of periodic points of any given period of the billiard map is finite, and let $f_Y(n)$ denote the number of periodic points whose minimal period is at most $n$. Suppose that the limit
$$h \;=\; \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\log f_Y(n)}{n}$$
exists and satisfies $0 < h < \infty$. Must $h$ equal the topological entropy of the billiard map?
artifact.status_search_result: For uniformly hyperbolic systems the exponential growth rate of periodic points equals the topological entropy (Bowen). For billiards, partial results exist: e.g., for two-dimensional hyperbolic billiards (Chernov) and for finite-horizon Sinai billiards (Baladi–Demers–Lima), and recently for generic convex billiards positive topological entropy and exponential periodic-orbit growth have been shown. However, a general equivalence between the growth rate $h$ (when it exists) and the topological entropy for arbitrary hyperbolic billiards (which are typically only non-uniformly hyperbolic with singularities) does not appear to be settled in full generality. Status appears unresolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Topological entropy and periodic points of two-dimensional hyperbolic billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Chernov relates topological entropy to periodic points for 2D hyperbolic billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results equate entropy to periodic-orbit growth in dimension two.

status_evidence.title: Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Generic convex billiards have positive topological entropy and exponential growth of periodic orbits.
status_evidence.claim: Positive entropy and exponential periodic-point growth shown only generically.

status_evidence.title: Topological Entropy and Pressure for Finite Horizon Sinai Billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Variational principle and entropy results for finite horizon Sinai billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Entropy/periodic point relations established in specific billiard classes, not universally.
